title: Technology Sector Update for 10/18/2018: TSM,ERIC,SAP
text:

Technology stocks were retreating in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing almost 1.5% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling nearly 2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ( TSM ) lost ground on Thursday, falling 2.4% after climbing earlier in the session. The company reported a 3.3% increase in Q3 revenue to NT$260.35 billion ($8.4 billion) and exceeding Wall Street projections looking for NT$257.80 billion.
In other sector news:
(+) Ericsson ( ERIC ) was stretching out its early gains, rising just over 6%, after the mobile communications equipment company reported Q3 net income excluding items of SEK1.03, or about $0.11, per share, reversing a SEK0.29 per share net loss during the same quarter last year. Sales rose to SEK53.8 billion from SEK49.4 billion a year earlier.
(-) SAP ( SAP ) dropped nearly 7% on Thursday. The company boosted its fully-year outlook as it posted a jump in Q3 revenue compared with year-ago levels, supported by growth in its cloud and software offerings. Revenue rose 8% year-over-year to EUR6.02 billion ($6.94 billion). Pre-tax profit declined 2% to EUR947 million from EUR993 million during the year-ago quarter while its operating profit slipped to EUR1.24 billion from EUR1.31 billion last year.
